'''Horoth Gendi''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by a [[Horoth Gendi's master|Hutt]] well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Gendi saved the life of his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] master in an act of quick-thinking [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]], and in reward the Hutt formally bequeathed the [[Nikto Sector]], a region of the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that had been known as a place for Nikto warriors to visit in order to gain employers, to Gendi. Gendi formed his [[Horoth Gendi's gang|own gang]] and used their aid to free himself from servitude, and a succession of Nikto gangs assumed control of the Nikto Sector in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horoth Gendi was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Nikto Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
